scoring_justification: For lattice parameter and elastic constants, compare to paper reference within tolerances (T0). For bulk modulus, Poisson's ratio, and optical peaks, recompute from agent's raw artifacts (T1: B0/v from submitted Cij; peaks from dielectric_function.csv). Structural checks on dielectric function CSV.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for lattice parameter, elastic constants, bulk modulus, Poisson's ratio, and reference peak energies
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 and text values (a0=0.4053393 nm, C11=181.00667 GPa, C12=37.28050 GPa, C44=38.86243 GPa, B0=85.18922 GPa, v=0.1708); peak energies 10.5 eV (strong) and 29.8 eV (small) from paper text/figures.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct copy from paper reported numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are taken from the paper's own reported results (Table 1 and text).

outputs.description: Equilibrium lattice parameter a0 of cubic Al3Sc.
Elastic stiffness constants C11, C12, C44, bulk modulus B0, and Poisson's ratio v.
Frequency-dependent complex dielectric function covering 0–40 eV; three columns: energy (eV), ε1, ε2.
Energies of the strong absorptive peak (0–15 eV) and the small peak (20–35 eV) in the dielectric function.

output_contract.notes: All values are computed from DFT using a plane-wave pseudopotential method with PBE-GGA. The checker verifies B0 and v consistency from Cij, and checks that the reported peak energies are derivable from the submitted dielectric function ε2.

steps.description: Lattice parameter a0 in nm, compare to paper reference with ±2% relative tolerance.
Check C11, C12, C44 within ±10% of paper values; recompute B0 and v from submitted Cij and verify consistency with paper-derived values within ±10%.
Structural checks: CSV has three numeric columns, ascending energy covering 0-40 eV, at least 50 data points.
Recompute peak energies from eps2 in dielectric_function.csv; compare to paper reference (strong ~10.5 eV, small ~29.8 eV) within absolute tolerance.
